name: Phantora
description: Uzbek-first cinema booking: ink surfaces, ivory type and a single gold accent, dark by default with a matching ivory theme.

typography.display: Syne Variable (700), headings and brand only
typography.numerals: Outfit, never Syne: Syne draws its zero as a round o

surfaces.glass-1: cards, chips; ivory 4% (dark) / white 50% (light); blur 14px (10px phones)
surfaces.glass-2: header, hero card, sticky bars; ink 74% / ivory 80%; blur 22px (16px phones)
surfaces.glass-3: modals, drawers, menu; ink 93% / ivory 96%; blur 30px (20px phones)

brand: Phantora brand kit: ticket mark with one gold dot; mark drawn inline in frontend/src/ui/Brand.tsx
principles: Gold is the only accent; it appears where a decision is.
One gold primary action per screen, always in the same place.
Surfaces carry the interface; solid colour carries seat and status meaning.
Seat state is shown by colour, pattern or icon, and text.
No motion behind content; the theatre backdrop is still.
Checkout is a demo and never implies a real charge.
